column1: # ocr-compare-run, 2026-10-12 20:17 to 2026-10-13 01:15: hybrid-run.sh in $STATE/ocrlab/compare, tools from 5a46b22,
# the 67 pages of OCR-SAMPLE-2026-10-04.tsv (11 newspaper, 56 other), each published by score-gate and scored by
# ux-harness --truth; made by hybrid-table.py (column meanings in its docstring). Every page of every run published.
# Download (du, OCR-HYBRID-DECISION-2026-10-12.md): Vision none; Falcon-OCR bf16 1.0 GB; PaddleOCR-VL 1.6 4-bit 682 MB;
# regions add DocLayout-YOLO's 72 MB (vision-regions needs only that), and every model needs the lab's Python and
# MLX runtime, about 0.8 GB, until ocr-integrate-engine packages one.
# peak_mb is the guard's sample of the reader's processes. vision-regions' reader is the layout model alone, done
# in about 3 s, so the guard often sampled only its shell (2 MB on newspapers); 612 MB is the most it caught. The
# app's own Vision memory is in no peak_mb.
# NewsBench is not here: its gold has no line boxes, which ux-harness --truth needs.
